item.title: CVE-2026-115815 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | The rus to lat advanced plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to blind SQL Injection via the 'name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

item.title: CVE-2026-115826 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4 | The Multi Step for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 2.9.1 via the '_cf7mls_db_form_data_id' parameter due to missing validation on a user controlled key. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to permanently delete arbitrary stored Contact Form 7 submissions from the database. Exploitation requires the companion CF7 Database plugin to be active and the per-form "Save every step, not just the final submission" option to be enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-116519 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Geo Mashup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author (comment form) / display_name (profile form)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.13.23 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The comment-author path requires the crafted comment to be approved before the payload is served to visitors; the subscriber-level path requires the plugin's user-location mapping feature to be enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-116594 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The Jeg Kit for Elementor – Powerful Addons for Elementor, Widgets & Templates for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'description' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful execution requires a published page containing both a Post Author widget in user_bio mode (rendering the attacker's biography) and any legitimate jkit_client_logo widget, so that client-logo.js is enqueued and the loadCarousel handler fires against the forged widget markup from the bio field.

item.title: CVE-2026-116758 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Advanced Country Blocker plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'REQUEST_URI' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected script is stored via the advcb_live_activity transient on the init hook and executed when an administrator views the Live Monitor page, as the stored URI is unsafely concatenated into a double-quoted HTML title attribute and inserted into the DOM via jQuery .html().

item.title: CVE-2026-116764 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1 | The The GDPR Framework By Data443 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.2. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to delete all postmeta rows for every Easy Digital Downloads payment order on the site, destroying order metadata belonging to all customers. Exploitation requires that Easy Digital Downloads 2.x is active and the GDPR Framework's EDD compatibility option is enabled with a delete or delete_and_notify action configured.

item.title: CVE-2026-118068 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The JobBoardWP – Job Board Listings and Submissions plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'job_description' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The plugin's default public submission workflow auto-provisions a jb_employer account for any visitor, meaning the effective entry point is unauthenticated — the custom role requirement imposes no real barrier on a stock install.

item.title: CVE-2026-118521 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | The Toolbox for Asgaros Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the replace_temp_pics function in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.4. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). This vulnerability is only reachable when the site administrator has enabled the Inline Image Upload feature (disabled by default).

item.title: CVE-2026-119631 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | The Kirki - Freeform Page Builder, Website Builder & Customizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Unauthorized Data Access in versions up to, and including, 6.4.1 via the `kirki_post_apis` AJAX action's `get-dynamic-content-batch` and `get-collection-batch` endpoints. This is due to the plugin opening these resolvers behind a site-wide, resource-unbound preview token (`EditorPreview::has_valid_token()`) that is NOT bound to the specific page the administrator intended to share, combined with the absence of any `list_users` or `can_user_read_post()` capability check inside `HelperFunctions::get_user_dynamic_content()` and `Collection::get_collection_batch()` — the equivalent checks ARE present on the plugin's own REST route (`FrontendRESTController::get_item_permissions_check()`). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers holding any valid read-only share link to extract from the entire user table every user's `user_email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `nickname`, `registered_date`, arbitrary string-valued `user_meta` (including custom keys such as `billing_phone`), and the e-mail address of every approved commenter — information that WordPress itself withholds from anonymous readers (served only in the `edit` context behind `list_users`).

item.title: CVE-2026-120564 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | The Search Everything plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in versions up to, and including, 8.1.9 via the search_everything AJAX action. The handler registered at `wp_ajax_search_everything` performs no capability check, no ownership check, and no nonce verification before running a WP_Query over `$_GET['s']` and returning the raw WP_Post objects — including the `post_password` field — as JSON. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to extract cleartext passwords for every password-protected post on the site and, when the plugin's draft/attachment/metadata search options are enabled by an administrator, to read draft and pending post contents they otherwise have no capability to view.

item.title: CVE-2026-122042 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | WarehousePG (WHPG) 6.27.1 through 6.27.7 and 7.2.1 through 7.6.1 are affected by an out-of-bounds write vulnerability (CWE-787) in gpfdist, the file server used to load and unload external tables. When gpfdist attaches a request to a session, it sizes two internal arrays from the client-supplied X-GP-SEGMENT-COUNT header and writes to them at the index given by the X-GP-SEGMENT-ID header, without checking that the index is non-negative and smaller than the count (CWE-129). gpfdist does not authenticate callers unless gpfdists is used with client certificate verification, so an attacker who can reach the gpfdist port can crash it with a single HTTP request, failing every external table load or unload that uses that gpfdist instance. gpfdist is normally reachable only from the cluster's internal network.

item.title: CVE-2026-123123 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | An attacker that is able to send a crafted network packet to the affected component may trigger an integer overflow during module size validation. This may cause insufficient bounds checking and result in out-of-bounds memory reads, potentially leading to a denial of service condition due to process termination.

item.title: CVE-2026-123419 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1 | The immonex Kickstart plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 1.19.0 via the 'inx-r-cidata (JSON blob containing 'template' and 'template_folders')' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to include and execute arbitrary .php files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where .php file types can be uploaded and included. The filename-level sanitization that strips dot-slash sequences applies only to the template filename component, not to the attacker-supplied template_folders directory paths, rendering it ineffective against directory traversal via that parameter.

item.title: CVE-2026-125053 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The WEB-Translation – eTranslation Multilingual plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit requires that at least one secondary language is configured in the plugin and that comments are open on the target post; because the stored payload contains no literal HTML brackets at save-time, WordPress core KSES filtering does not remove it, and the malicious script is only materialized when a visitor loads the post under a secondary-language URL slug.

item.title: CVE-2026-126131 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The WP Instant Feeds plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data[images][][url]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The cache-write AJAX endpoint is accessible to unauthenticated users because the only access control is a nonce check against a nonce minted for uid 0 and freely emitted on any front-end page rendering a feed via wp_localize_script, making it harvestable by any unauthenticated visitor.

item.title: CVE-2026-129323 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. item.title: CVE-2026-132138 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | A flaw was found in cyrus-sasl. item.title: CVE-2026-92535 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | The Make Connector plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.6 via the include_custom_fields. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract arbitrary admin-selected user, post, comment, and term metadata exposed via core REST endpoints — including active session tokens with source IP, user-agent, login and expiry timestamps, capability sets, and any other admin-selected private meta keys including protected underscore-prefixed entries. This is exploitable because the plugin's meta picker queries all meta keys from the database without filtering, offering protected underscore-prefixed keys such as session_tokens and wp_capabilities for administrator selection; if any such keys are selected, their values become readable without any credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-96665 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The SendPress Newsletters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'sp_firstname' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.26.1.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The public subscriber-management route uses an unsigned, forgeable base64-encoded JSON token, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to impersonate any subscriber and obtain a valid nonce — bypassing the POST handler's only access control check.

item.title: CVE-2026-96841 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The ITRO Popup Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_html' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.2.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable by low-privileged roles such as Subscriber when an administrator has explicitly granted that role access to the plugin settings page via the plugin's role selection option.
